instructions: There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.question: Choose the correct answer from any seven of the following :

A reduced incidence matrix of linear graph is given below :
$$A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 1 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 & -1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$$
Assume that the branches 2, 3 and 4 are twigs. Determine $Q_f$ and verify by drawing the graph using interrelation among various matrices.

Two identical sections of a network are shown in Fig. 4 below : (Ladder with $2 \Omega$ and $1 \Omega$ series, $1 \Omega$ and $2 \Omega$ shunt). Determine overall inverse hybrid parameters of the combined network.

Consider the R-C parallel circuit as shown in Fig. 5 below with $R = 0.5 \Omega$ and $C = 4$ F excited by d.c. current source of 10 amp : (Switch closes at $t=0$). Determine the voltage across the capacitor at $t = 2$ s. Also draw the s domain representation.
What are the steps of basic synthesis procedure?

Synthesize the following impedance function using Foster forms I and II :
$$Z(s) = \frac{s(s^2 + 10)}{(s^2 + 4)(s^2 + 16)}$$
Using interrelation among various parameters, derive Y parameter in terms of Z and ABCD parameters.
Design a band pass, constant k filter with cutoff frequency of 4 kHz and 10 kHz and nominal characteristic impedance of 500 $\Omega$.
